title: 조성아 Seonga Cho
text:
안녕하세요
KAIST 디지털인문사회과학부에서 GIS(Geographic Information Science) 분야 조교수로 재직 중인 조성아입니다.
박사과정에서 GIS 분야 및 공간최적화(Spatial Optimization)를 전공하였으며, 다양한 공간 데이터 분석 및 방법론 개발, 도시 내 사회 문제에 관심을 갖고 있습니다. 구체적으로는 도시 내 사회적 약자들의 복지 시설 접근성, 서비스 이용 가능성 계산, 연속 공간에서의 다목적 공간최적화 문제 해결 등이 있습니다. 또한 공간적 맥락이 지니는 사회 현상의 영향력과 공간 데이터가 지니는 불확실성에 대한 연구를 지속하고 있습니다.
연구에 관심이 있거나 인턴, 대학원 지원 등이 궁금한 경우, seonga_geo@kaist.ac.kr로 부담 없이 연락주시기 바랍니다.

title: 조성아 Seonga Cho
text:
Welcome to the SSAG Lab
As an Assistant Professor at the School of Digital Humanities and Computational Social Sciences at KAIST (appointed in 2025) and Adjunct Professor in the Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, I investigate societal and environmental impacts through spatial analysis. My research integrates geographic information systems (GIS) and spatial optimization methodologies to address challenges in urban dynamics, demographic transitions, and human-environment interactions.
My work develops spatial analytics frameworks to decode complex social phenomena. Core themes include urban dynamics, where GIS-based approaches map inequities in infrastructure access through coverage modeling. A second focus lies in location analytics, which identifies non-dominated solutions for multi-objective spatial optimization problems within continuous space, particularly in resource allocation and service accessibility. Finally, emerging applications extend spatial paradigms to novel domains, such as optimizing outfielder positioning in sports analytics and evaluating welfare facility accessibility in rural regions.
Please contact me when you have any questions related to future collaborations.

title: Research
text:
Selected papers



  
    2025
    
      Locational Decision-Making and Representational Impacts
      S. Cho, A. T. Murray, S. Dodge, and R. L. Church, The Professional Geographer
      This research explored the disparity between the non-dominated solutions derived from continuous space and discretely approximated surfaces. The impact of spatial representation in spatial optimization was dealt in this paper.
    
    
    
    
  

  
    2024
    
      Correlation between Hotspots of Child Maltreatment and Neighborhood-Level Interventions
      S. Cho, S. Kim, and B. Lee, Child Indicators Research
      This paper is dealing with the spatial pattern of child maltreatment and the impact of social and spatial context on it. The neighborhood intervention trend was explored in this research.
    
    
    
    
  

  
    2023
    
      Improving Locational Decision Making: a heuristic that optimizes access and coverage
      S. Cho, A. T. Murray, S. Dodge, and J. Baik, International Journal of Geographical Information Science
      This research proposed λ interval heuristic method that can derive non-dominated solutions in continuous space. The results showed the superiority of the algorithm in continuous space to the derived solutions from the discretely approximated surface.
    
    
    
    
  

  
    2022
    
      Spatio-temporal Multi-objective Optimization for Competitive Mobile Vendors Location and Routing Using De Facto Population Demands
      S. Cho and G. Lee, Geographical Analysis
      The optimal locations and trajectories of food trucks were identified considering the de facto population and existing restaurants in Seoul.
